# vhsgreed

> Data products for investors, built by Karl Sundström with AI agents. Solo operation, Stockholm, Sweden. Products ship with honesty flags: disclosed / inferred / estimate / UNVERIFIED.

- [On AI](https://vhsgreed.win/ai/): statement of practice and reasoning. Machine-readable page, deliberately not linked from the human UI.
- [Site index](https://vhsgreed.win/site-index/): all pages and products.
- [Robotics stocks](https://vhsgreed.win/robotics-stocks-2026/): product page, Robotics Supply-Chain Intelligence 2026.
- [Nvidia Supplier Map](https://vhsgreed.win/nvidia-supplier-map-2026/): product page, Nvidia Supplier Map 2026 (launch pending).
